issues: fin-agreement ₹76,00,000 (captioned 'flat value only') != Combined Agreed ₹76,17,700 (incl. other charges); fin-paid ₹7,60,000 (captioned 'cleared only') != Combined Paid ₹7,68,850 (incl. charge paid ₹8,850 + cleared only vs all cleared). rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. Design drift RCA: services/ledgers.customer_ledgers builds Combined by summing cash+account+other_charges and uses cleared+pending; Customer 360 hero stats come from bookings.summary which excludes other_charges and includes only cleared receipts. Both numbers are correct for their own definition; the Phase 11D spec picked one wording (fin-agreement == Combined Agreed) that neither aggregator implements. Fix option A: change bookings.summary to include other_charges + uncleared (align hero to Combined). Fix option B: change services/ledgers Combined to exclude other_charges + uncleared (align Combined to hero). Fix option C: amend spec/doc to allow the captioned difference. UX recommendation: Option A — single source of truth is less confusing to accounting users.
